facts.business: The company is engaged in trading of food products, mainly milk, collecting raw material and supplying it to big dairies for finished products.

capacity_or_capex.item: Cattle farm development with improved technology

guidance_or_targets.statement: The management expects higher turnover in the Current Year.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: (a) Scheme of Reduction of Capital approved by shareholders at EGM on 27/03/2025, subject to NCLT approval. (b) Management fails to provide procedure for maintaining audit trail as per Rule 3(1) of Companies (Accounts) Rules, 2014. (c) Balances of Trade Receivables, Trade Payables, Loans, deposits and advances are subject to confirmation and reconciliation.

key_risks: External factors: market competition and availability of cheaper material
Internal factors: perishable nature of product
facts.related_party_note: There is no investment in securities neither loan given to any Body Corporate. During the financial year 2025-26, the Company has not given any loan to any Company including Associate Concern.
